vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: agenttimes
Version: 5.5.0

The agenttimes skill is a legitimate news and data API wrapper that uses curl to interact with https://agenttimes.live. It provides endpoints for semantic news search, weather, crypto prices, and sentiment analysis, with no evidence of malicious execution, data exfiltration, or prompt injection. The documentation in SKILL.md is transparent about its functionality and security measures for webhooks.

llm.summary: The skill's declared purpose (news/search API) matches its instructions and requirements — it only needs curl and calls public HTTP endpoints — but it sends user queries and results to a third-party service, so be careful with sensitive data.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (news intelligence, semantic search, weather, crypto) matches the SKILL.md. The only required binary is curl, which is appropriate for an instruction-only skill that calls HTTP endpoints.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: All runtime instructions are curl GET/POST calls to https://agenttimes.live endpoints (search, trending, prices, subscribe). The instructions do not request local files, environment variables, or unrelated credentials. However, the skill will transmit whatever you ask (including any sensitive text) to a third-party server, and it can create webhook subscriptions that notify external endpoints.

dimensions.detail: No install spec or code files; instruction-only with no artifacts written to disk. This is the lowest-risk install model.

llm.guidance: This skill is internally consistent with its stated purpose, but it calls a third-party HTTP service (agenttimes.live). Before installing, consider: (1) Do not send secrets, passwords, private PII, or internal URLs in queries — anything you query will go to that external service. (2) Webhook subscriptions will cause that service to POST data to endpoints you provide — validate webhook URLs and expect external network traffic. (3) Confirm the service's trustworthiness, privacy policy, and pricing for paid endpoints (/search). (4) If you operate in a sensitive environment, restrict or review outbound network access for the agent or test in isolation first.
